title: Understanding Orthogonality
text: When we say two vectors are orthogonal, it means their dot product is zero. Think about what this implies for the relationship between the residuals $$(Y-hatY)$$ and the predictions (hatY).

title: Exploring the Residuals
text: The residuals, Y-hatY, represent the difference between the actual outcomes and the predicted outcomes. Consider how these residuals relate to the space spanned by the columns of the design matrix X.

title: Checking Orthogonality
text: What does it mean for Y-hatY to be orthogonal to hatY?
